title: A DOC fact a change adds without an anchor quote is caught at that change's landing, not left to a later item
goal: The landing's lint step fails the change that adds a DOC fact whose source has no anchor with a quote, naming the fact, so the anchor row lands in the same item; and texts-catalogue-formats.md's FluentLocalization fact (S1710) gets its anchor. In SP-lsamtvsz the research commit ffc605f25 added that fact with only a lint warning; the next item that touched the line (BG-nzrj2n32) saw the warning but _anchors.csv was outside its touches.

run:
import sys, importlib.util
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("kblint", ".claude/skills/kb-verify/lint.py")
lint = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(lint)
import kbcommon, kbfacts
root = next(r for r in kbcommon.roots() if r.name == "public")
src = kbcommon.source_rows()
quotable = set(s for s, r in src.items() if (r.get("reuse") or "").strip() in ("copy", "quote") and not lint.microsoft_host(r.get("url")))
pick = None
for path in sorted(kbfacts.articles()):
    for u in kbfacts.units(path):
        if any(part["kind"] == "DOC" and set(part["ids"]) & quotable for part in u["tags"]):
            pick = (kbfacts.bare(path), u)
            break
    if pick:
        break
bare, unit = pick
planted = dict(unit, text=unit["text"] + " planted words no anchor knows")
lint.changed_articles = lambda r, base: set([bare])
lint.new_facts = lambda r, base, p, text: [planted] if p == bare else []
found = []
lint.lint_root(root, [lint.qualified("kb/public/" + bare)], lambda level, path, msg: found.append((level, msg)) if "DOC fact added" in msg else None, "HEAD")
print(found[:1], file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(0 if found and all(level == "ERROR" for level, _ in found) else 1)
